summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency resolves and executes at install time
details: package.json declares `libsignal` with the source `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` — a non-registry GitHub reference with no commit SHA or tag. On `npm install`, this dependency is fetched from whatever is currently on that repository's default branch, with no integrity check and no version pin, and any lifecycle scripts inside the fetched repo execute on the installer's machine. The referenced GitHub account (RahmadTenpoles) is a third party unrelated to the npm publisher of raiden-baileys, so arbitrary code reaching installers is controlled by an account outside the package's own publishing identity. Whatever the repository contains today, the executed content can change at any time without a new release of raiden-baileys.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
